records.title_en: Muscle labels need a movement layer
records.title_zh: 肌群标签与动作之间需要一层动作模式
records.population: Foundational human anatomy; educational use for generally healthy adults.
records.summary_zh: 只给动作贴上“胸”或“腿”的标签不够。SportRX 先记录肌群的主要关节动作，再用水平推、垂直拉、膝主导、髋铰链等动作家族连接具体变式。
records.technical_summary_en: The atlas inserts movement families between anatomical regions and individual catalogue exercises.
records.limitations: This is an expert-curated educational taxonomy, not a physiological stimulus measurement or validated score.

records.title_en: Primary and secondary muscle coverage are not equal
records.title_zh: 直接覆盖与协同覆盖不能等量计算
records.population: Generally healthy adults using resistance-training exercise catalogues.
records.summary_zh: 卧推会用到胸肌、三角肌前束和肱三头肌，但这不意味着一组卧推对三者提供完全相同的增肌剂量。图谱只描述覆盖关系，不生成小数化的“有效组”分数。
records.technical_summary_en: Compound exercise participation does not justify equal hypertrophy credit for every participating muscle.
records.limitations: SportRX does not measure internal muscle force, activation or individual regional adaptation.

records.title_zh: 动作变化要系统化，而不是随机换动作
records.population: Young men in eight resistance-training studies.
records.summary_zh: 不同动作可能影响区域性增肌和专项力量，但证据支持的是有解剖与生物力学理由的系统变化，不是每次训练随机换一套动作。过度变化和高度重复的变式反而会削弱学习与追踪。
records.technical_summary_en: Systematic variation may support regional adaptation; excessive random or redundant variation can compromise gains.
records.limitations: Only eight studies with 241 young men were included, so findings are not universal.

records.title_en: Machines and free weights are both valid tools
records.title_zh: 器械与自由重量都可以是有效工具
records.population: Healthy adults aged 18-60 years in comparative resistance-training studies.
records.summary_zh: 直接比较没有显示自由重量或固定器械在增肌上稳定胜出。选择应结合目标、偏好、器械条件和能否稳定进阶，但不同设备的负重数字不能直接互换。
records.technical_summary_en: Hypertrophy outcomes did not differ directly between modalities, while strength adaptation remained test and modality specific.
records.limitations: Only five studies reported hypertrophy and average equivalence does not imply identical mechanics or individual tolerance.

records.title_en: Range of motion needs exercise context
records.title_zh: 动作幅度需要结合具体动作解释
records.population: Healthy adults in longitudinal resistance-training studies.
records.summary_zh: 完整动作幅度对下肢增肌有更有利的证据，但上肢证据有限且不一致。SportRX 把可控的完整幅度作为一般记录起点，不会替用户判断疼痛状态下的适用幅度。
records.technical_summary_en: Full ROM has more favorable lower-limb hypertrophy evidence, but upper-body findings and individual applicability remain uncertain.
records.limitations: The review does not establish a universally safe or optimal range for every exercise and person.

records.title_en: Longer muscle length is a promising but uncertain selector
records.title_zh: 较长肌长是可考虑因素，但不是动作排名器
records.summary_zh: 在较长平均肌长下训练可能对部分区域有小幅优势，但汇总效应较小且有不确定性。它适合作为选择互补变式的一个因素，不足以生成“最佳动作榜”。
records.technical_summary_en: Longer-muscle-length training showed a small trend toward greater distal hypertrophy with uncertainty.
records.limitations: Studies were in young adults and varied by muscle, method and region.

records.title_zh: 优先动作可以放在训练前部
records.population: Healthy adults in resistance-training exercise-order studies.
records.summary_zh: 先练的动作通常更有利于该动作的力量提升，因此主要技能或力量目标可放在前面。现有证据没有证明复合动作永远先做，或预疲劳能稳定增加肌肥大。
records.technical_summary_en: Strength gains favor exercises performed early; hypertrophy did not show a clear multi-joint-first versus single-joint-first effect.
records.limitations: Hypertrophy studies were limited and do not establish a universal session order.

records.title_zh: 孤立动作是按需要添加的工具
records.population: Healthy adults in comparative resistance-training studies.
records.summary_zh: 复合动作适合提供广泛覆盖，孤立动作可在局部目标、器械条件或训练时间允许时补充。证据不支持“每个部位必须有孤立动作”，也不支持“复合动作永远足够”。
records.technical_summary_en: Single-joint work is a contextual complement rather than a universal requirement or redundant category.
records.limitations: Comparative evidence is small and often focused on upper-limb outcomes.

records.title_en: Chest coverage uses push and adduction families
records.title_zh: 胸肌覆盖由推与夹胸两类动作构成
records.population: Generally healthy adults selecting chest resistance exercises.
records.summary_zh: 水平推承担胸肌主要复合覆盖，夹胸或飞鸟补充更直接的肩水平内收。上斜、平板与下斜可以作为变式，但系统不会承诺某个角度精确增加某一区域。
records.technical_summary_en: The atlas uses horizontal pressing plus optional adduction-dominant work without claiming exact regional isolation.
records.limitations: No individual regional hypertrophy is inferred from bench angle or exercise name.

records.title_en: Back coverage separates vertical and horizontal pulling
records.title_zh: 背部覆盖要区分垂直拉与水平拉
records.population: Generally healthy adults selecting back resistance exercises.
records.summary_zh: 垂直拉更直接表达肩内收和伸展，水平拉同时涉及肩伸、水平外展和肩胛后缩。两类动作有重叠，但不能用一个笼统的“背部动作”完全替代。
records.technical_summary_en: Vertical and horizontal pulling overlap but provide distinguishable movement-task coverage.
records.limitations: The broad back region contains several muscles; exact stimulus cannot be inferred from labels.

records.title_en: Shoulder coverage separates three deltoid regions
records.title_zh: 肩部覆盖应区分三角肌前中后束
records.population: Generally healthy adults selecting shoulder resistance exercises.
records.summary_zh: 肩上推主要覆盖前束并协同覆盖中束和肱三头肌；侧平举更直接对应肩外展；后肩动作对应水平外展。三类不应压缩成一个笼统的 delts 标签。
records.technical_summary_en: The atlas separates anterior, lateral and posterior deltoid coverage by movement task.
records.limitations: Movement labels do not quantify regional activation or hypertrophy, and pain suitability is outside scope.

records.title_en: Arm work combines compound contribution and direct actions
records.title_zh: 手臂训练要同时看复合贡献与直接动作
records.population: Generally healthy adults selecting upper-arm resistance exercises.
records.summary_zh: 拉类会让肘屈肌参与，推类会让肱三头肌参与；弯举和臂屈伸则提供更直接的肘屈、肘伸覆盖。是否加入直接动作取决于局部目标与时间。
records.technical_summary_en: Elbow flexors and extensors receive compound contribution and can also be trained through direct action families.
records.limitations: The evidence does not establish a universal amount of direct arm work.

records.title_en: Quadriceps coverage uses knee-dominant and direct knee-extension tasks
records.title_zh: 股四头肌覆盖包括膝主导与直接膝伸
records.population: Generally healthy adults selecting quadriceps resistance exercises.
records.summary_zh: 深蹲、腿举和分腿动作提供复合膝伸覆盖，腿屈伸提供更直接的膝伸任务。它们可以互补，但不同动作幅度与器械负重不能直接横向比较。
records.technical_summary_en: Quadriceps coverage includes multi-joint knee-dominant patterns and optional direct knee extension.
records.limitations: No individual squat depth, stance or joint suitability is prescribed.

records.title_en: Hamstrings need hip-hinge and knee-flexion coverage
records.title_zh: 腘绳肌覆盖要区分髋铰链与屈膝
records.population: Generally healthy adults selecting posterior-thigh resistance exercises.
records.summary_zh: 腘绳肌跨髋和膝，罗马尼亚硬拉等髋铰链与腿弯举等屈膝动作表达不同任务。只做一类不能被描述为完整覆盖所有功能。
records.technical_summary_en: Hamstring programming should preserve hip-extension and knee-flexion movement families.
records.limitations: The atlas does not predict regional hamstring growth or assess lumbar and knee symptoms.

records.title_en: Gluteal coverage spans more than one exercise family
records.title_zh: 臀肌覆盖不应只依赖一个动作家族
records.population: Generally healthy adults selecting gluteal resistance exercises.
records.summary_zh: 臀肌训练可以由蹲类、髋铰链、臀桥和髋外展等家族共同构成。动作之间有重叠但任务不同，因此不建立“唯一练臀动作”的排名。
records.technical_summary_en: Gluteal coverage spans squat, hinge, bridge and abduction-related movement tasks.
records.limitations: The gluteal group contains distinct muscles and regions; exact regional growth is not inferred.

records.title_en: Calf raises should preserve knee-position context
records.title_zh: 提踵记录要保留膝关节位置
records.population: Generally healthy adults selecting calf resistance exercises.
records.summary_zh: 站姿与坐姿提踵都训练跖屈，但膝关节位置不同。SportRX 会保留直膝、屈膝和器械设置，避免把不同测试条件的表现混在一起。
records.technical_summary_en: Calf exercise records should preserve straight- versus bent-knee setup and equipment context.
records.limitations: No optimal calf exercise or isolated-muscle claim is made.

records.title_en: Trunk flexion and stability tasks are different
records.title_zh: 躯干屈曲与稳定任务应分开记录
records.population: Foundational anatomy and educational exercise categorisation.
records.summary_zh: 卷腹表达主动躯干屈曲，死虫、侧桥和 Pallof press 表达不同方向的稳定任务。它们不是同一个动作模式，也不构成腰痛诊断或康复建议。
records.technical_summary_en: The atlas separates active trunk flexion from resisting extension, rotation and lateral flexion.
records.limitations: This movement taxonomy does not validate trunk hypertrophy dose or spinal rehabilitation.

records.title_en: Forearm hypertrophy and grip performance are not the same outcome
records.title_zh: 前臂增肌与握力表现不是同一个结果
records.population: Foundational anatomy and educational exercise categorisation.
records.summary_zh: 腕屈、腕伸和负重握持是不同任务。现有上游动作库对握持动作覆盖不足，因此 SportRX 只把它们作为动作发现标签，不用握力成绩替代前臂肌肥大测量。
records.technical_summary_en: Wrist actions and grip tasks should be distinguished, and grip performance should not proxy forearm hypertrophy.
records.limitations: The current catalogue does not comprehensively cover loaded carries or grip devices.
